candidates.statement: Inventory's redis reserve_inventory calls time out (~2s), returning 503 on /v1/reservations; order's call to inventory then ReadTimeouts, and gateway /v1/orders and /v1/checkout return 502. Traces show redis timeout errors and inventory metrics show 13.9 503s on /v1/reservations with redis reserve_inventory operations.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs not admitted; root cause of redis timeouts (saturation vs network) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts in inventory, cascading to 503 reservations, order ReadTimeouts, and 502 checkout/orders at gateway. Inventory metrics confirm 503s on /v1/reservations tied to redis reserve_inventory. Deployment record only shows baseline inventory v1.0.0 and does not establish causation.
